note: SUPERTREND-KR-V1 baseline (STEP 2). SuperTrend (Olivier Seban, 2008) as standardised by TradingView built-in and most libraries: ATR period 10, multiplier 3.0, Wilder EMA (alpha=1/10), source = (High+Low)/2. Recursive final bands. Long only: Entry on DOWN->UP trend flip (close crosses above final_ub), Exit on UP->DOWN flip (close crosses below final_lb). Dynamic trend-reversal exit NOT expressible in engine.executor's fixed STOP/TARGET/TIME contract, so driver-driven exactly like MACD/Squeeze: engine DATA layer (A2aProvider/UniverseProvider/calendar/_drop_suspension_rows), engine PORTFOLIO accounting (engine.portfolio.Portfolio), CostModel, engine.metrics - not engine.executor.simulate_trade.

signal.entry: trend[t-1] == DOWN AND trend[t] == UP (close crosses above final_ub)
signal.exit: trend[t-1] == UP AND trend[t] == DOWN (close crosses below final_lb)

exit.note: Trend reversal exit is a dynamic (state-machine) exit, NOT a static stop/target/time. Implemented in the research driver, not engine.executor.

pit.rule: no signal on/before ticker's A1a listedAt. Gateway applied at the signal date t: t < listedAt -> signal discarded. Entry is at next_session(t) so it is necessarily after listedAt.

period.note: Indicator warm-up uses pre-2016 bars; only trades with signal_date >= performanceStart are generated/measured.
